newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso closes lower at 1,045.10.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso closes lower at 1,045.10.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed lower after a day of extremely thin trading due to the Labor Day holiday in the United States.
Interbank dealers said the peso traded in a 1,043.70 to 1,045.90 range and closed at 1,045.10, 1.5 pesos lower on the dollar than Friday's close.

The market was very quiet because of the holiday," one interbank trader said in a telephone interview. He said dealers had reported just 54 trades for a total of $18 million, less than a fifth of the daily average so far this year.
